barbecue.example_en: We ate barbecue in the garden on Saturday evening.
barbecue.example_zh: 星期六晚上，我们在花园里吃了烧烤。

barber.example_en: The barber trimmed my hair before the school photo.
barber.example_zh: 拍学校照片之前，理发员给我修剪了头发。

bargain.example_en: This jacket was a real bargain at the weekend market.
bargain.example_zh: 这件夹克在周末市场上真是一件便宜货。

bark.example_en: The dog's bark woke the baby at midnight.
bark.example_zh: 半夜，一阵狗吠把宝宝吵醒了。

barman.example_en: The barman poured orange juice for my uncle.
barman.example_zh: 酒保给叔叔倒了一杯橙汁。

barrel.example_en: A wooden barrel stood beside the farm gate.
barrel.example_zh: 农场大门旁立着一只木桶。

baseball.example_en: We played baseball on the field after school.
baseball.example_zh: 放学后我们在球场上打了棒球。

basin.example_en: Mum washed the rice in a large basin.
basin.example_zh: 妈妈在大盆里把米洗干净了。

basis.example_en: Honesty is the basis of a strong friendship.
basis.example_zh: 诚实是一份牢固友谊的基础。

basket.example_en: She carried a basket of eggs from the market.
basket.example_zh: 她从市场提回一篮子鸡蛋。

basketball.example_en: Tom practices basketball with his brother every evening.
basketball.example_zh: 汤姆每天晚上和哥哥一起练习篮球。

bastard.example_en: In the old play, the king called him a bastard.
bastard.example_zh: 在那出老戏里，国王叫他私生子。

bat.example_en: He swung the bat and hit the ball hard.
bat.example_zh: 他挥动球棒，狠狠击中了球。

batch.example_en: The baker made a fresh batch of biscuits.
batch.example_zh: 面包师做了一批新鲜饼干。

bath.example_en: I take a hot bath after football practice.
bath.example_zh: 足球训练后我会洗个热水澡。

battery.example_en: My phone battery died during the bus ride home.
battery.example_zh: 坐公交车回家时，我的手机电池没电了。

battle.example_en: Soldiers from two villages fought a long battle beside the river.
battle.example_zh: 两个村子的士兵在河边打了一场很长的会战。

bay.example_en: Our family rented a boat on the quiet bay.
bay.example_zh: 我们一家人在平静的海湾租了一条船。

bean.example_en: There is a bean in my soup today.
bean.example_zh: 今天我的汤里有一颗豆子。

beard.example_en: Grandpa's beard turned white after many years.
beard.example_zh: 许多年过去后，爷爷的胡子变白了。

beast.example_en: The beast in the storybook lived in a dark forest.
beast.example_zh: 故事书里的走兽住在黑暗的森林中。

beauty.example_en: Her beauty drew smiles from everyone at the party.
beauty.example_zh: 她的美貌让聚会上的每个人都露出了笑容。

beaver.example_en: A beaver built a dam across the small river.
beaver.example_zh: 一只河狸在小河上筑了一道坝。

bed.example_en: I made my bed before leaving for school.
bed.example_zh: 去上学之前，我把床铺好了。

bedside.example_en: Mum left a glass of water at my bedside.
bedside.example_zh: 妈妈在我床边放了一杯水。

bee.example_en: A bee landed on the flower near our window.
bee.example_zh: 一只蜜蜂落在我们窗户附近的花上。

beef.example_en: We had beef and rice for Sunday dinner.
beef.example_zh: 星期天晚饭我们吃了牛肉和米饭。

been.example_en: Anna has been captain of the team this term.
been.example_zh: 安娜这个学期一直是球队队长。

beginner.example_en: As a beginner, I can swim only a short distance.
beginner.example_zh: 作为初学者，我只能游很短的距离。

beginning.example_en: The beginning of the film made the children laugh.
beginning.example_zh: 电影的开头把孩子们逗笑了。

behalf.example_en: I spoke on behalf of the class at the meeting.
behalf.example_zh: 我在会上代表全班发了言。

behavior.example_en: His polite behavior impressed the guests at dinner.
behavior.example_zh: 他有礼貌的行为让晚餐上的客人印象深刻。

behaviour.example_en: Good behaviour on the bus keeps everyone safe.
behaviour.example_zh: 公交车上的良好行为能保障每个人的安全。

being.example_en: A human being needs water every day.
being.example_zh: 人这种生物每天都需要水。

Belgium.example_en: My pen friend lives in Belgium with her family.
Belgium.example_zh: 我的笔友和家人一起住在比利时。

bell.example_en: The school bell rang and we lined up.
bell.example_zh: 学校的铃响了，我们站好了队。

belly.example_en: The baby patted his round belly after drinking milk.
belly.example_zh: 宝宝喝完奶，拍了拍自己圆圆的肚子。

belt.example_en: He tightened his belt before the long hike.
belt.example_zh: 长途步行之前，他把腰带系紧了。

bench.example_en: Grandma sat on a bench in the sunny park.
bench.example_zh: 奶奶坐在阳光明媚的公园长椅上。

Bible.example_en: She reads a page of the Bible before bed.
Bible.example_zh: 她睡觉前会读一页《圣经》。

bicycle.example_en: I ride my bicycle to school when the weather is fine.
bicycle.example_zh: 天气好的时候，我骑自行车去上学。

bike.example_en: His new bike has a bright red basket.
bike.example_zh: 他的新自行车上装着一个鲜红的车筐。

bill.example_en: Dad paid the electricity bill at the bank.
bill.example_zh: 爸爸在银行付了电费帐单。

bin.example_en: Throw the empty bottle into the recycling bin.
bin.example_zh: 把空瓶子扔进回收垃圾桶。

biochemistry.example_en: She chose biochemistry because she loves lab experiments.
biochemistry.example_zh: 她选了生化，因为她喜欢做实验。

biography.example_en: I borrowed a biography of a famous scientist.
biography.example_zh: 我借了一本著名科学家的传记。

biology.example_en: Our biology teacher brought a model of the heart.
biology.example_zh: 我们的生物学老师带来了一个心脏模型。

bird.example_en: A small bird built a nest outside the classroom.
bird.example_zh: 一只小鸟在教室外面筑了巢。

birth.example_en: The baby's birth brought joy to the whole family.
birth.example_zh: 宝宝的出生给全家带来了喜悦。

birthday.example_en: We baked a cake for Mum's birthday on Saturday.
birthday.example_zh: 星期六我们为妈妈的生日烤了一个蛋糕。

biscuit.example_en: He dipped a biscuit into his warm milk.
biscuit.example_zh: 他把饼干蘸进了温热的牛奶里。

bishop.example_en: The bishop spoke kindly to the children at church.
bishop.example_zh: 主教在教堂里和蔼地对孩子们说话。

bit.example_en: Add a bit of salt to the soup, please.

bite.example_en: He took a big bite of the apple.

blackboard.example_en: The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.
blackboard.example_zh: 老师把日期写在了黑板上。

blessing.example_en: Good health is a blessing for every family.
blessing.example_zh: 身体健康对每个家庭都是福气。

block.example_en: The library is one block from our school gate.
block.example_zh: 图书馆离我们学校大门只有一个街区。

blog.example_en: She writes a travel blog about weekend trips.
blog.example_zh: 她写一个旅行博客，记录周末的出行。

blogger.example_en: That food blogger posted a photo of her noodles.
blogger.example_zh: 那位美食博主发了一张自己面条的照片。

bloke.example_en: A friendly bloke helped us find the right bus.
bloke.example_zh: 一个友善的家伙帮我们找到了该坐的公交车。

blood.example_en: The nurse took a sample of my blood.
blood.example_zh: 护士抽了一点我的血做样本。

bloom.example_en: The first bloom on the rose appeared in April.
bloom.example_zh: 四月里，那株玫瑰开出了第一朵花。

blush.example_en: A deep blush spread across her face.
blush.example_zh: 她脸上泛起了一片深深的红晕。

board.example_en: Pin the notice on the board outside the office.
board.example_zh: 把通知钉在办公室外面的板子上。

boat.example_en: We rowed a small boat across the calm lake.
boat.example_zh: 我们划着小船穿过了平静的湖面。

body.example_en: Exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
body.example_zh: 锻炼能让你的身体保持强壮和健康。

bomb.example_en: The museum displayed an old bomb from the war.
bomb.example_zh: 博物馆展出了一枚战争时期的旧炸弹。

bond.example_en: A strong bond grew between the two brothers.
bond.example_zh: 兄弟俩之间建立起牢固的纽带。

bone.example_en: The dog buried a bone under the garden tree.
bone.example_zh: 那只狗把一根骨头埋在花园的树下。

bonus.example_en: Workers received a bonus after a busy month.
bonus.example_zh: 忙碌了一个月之后，工人们领到了红利。

book.example_en: I finished the book under the lamp last night.
book.example_zh: 昨晚我在灯下把那本书读完了。

bookcase.example_en: The bookcase in my room is full of novels.
bookcase.example_zh: 我房间里的书柜塞满了小说。

booking.example_en: Our booking at the hotel starts on Friday.
booking.example_zh: 我们在酒店的预约从星期五开始。

bookshelf.example_en: Dad fixed the bookshelf that had come loose.
bookshelf.example_zh: 爸爸把松动的书架修好了。

bookshop.example_en: I bought a dictionary at the bookshop near school.
bookshop.example_zh: 我在学校附近的书店买了一本词典。

bookstore.example_en: The downtown bookstore stays open until nine.
bookstore.example_zh: 市中心的书局一直营业到九点。

boom.example_en: The boom of thunder shook the classroom windows.
boom.example_zh: 雷的轰鸣震动了教室的窗户。

boot.example_en: Mud covered his left boot after the rainy hike.
boot.example_zh: 雨中徒步之后，泥巴糊满了他的左脚长靴。

border.example_en: We showed our passports at the border this morning.
border.example_zh: 今天早上我们在边界出示了护照。

boredom.example_en: Long rainy weekends can bring real boredom.
boredom.example_zh: 漫长的阴雨周末真会让人厌烦。

boss.example_en: Her boss praised the team for finishing early.
boss.example_zh: 她的老板表扬了提前完成工作的团队。

bottle.example_en: I filled a bottle with cold water for the match.
bottle.example_zh: 我灌了一瓶冷水，准备比赛时喝。

bottom.example_en: Seaweed stuck to the bottom of the old boat.
bottom.example_zh: 海草粘在那艘旧船的底面上。

boundary.example_en: A fence marks the boundary of the school field.
boundary.example_zh: 一道篱笆标出了学校操场的边界。

bow.example_en: The violin bow slipped from her hand during practice.
bow.example_zh: 练习时，小提琴的琴弓从她手里滑了下去。

bowl.example_en: He ate noodles from a blue bowl at lunch.
bowl.example_zh: 午饭时他用一只蓝碗吃面条。

box.example_en: I packed the gift in a small box.
box.example_zh: 我把礼物装进了一个小盒子里。

boxing.example_en: Boxing practice left his arms sore and tired.
boxing.example_zh: 拳击训练让他的两条胳膊又酸又累。

boy.example_en: The boy shared his umbrella with a classmate.
boy.example_zh: 那个男孩和同学合打一把伞。

boyfriend.example_en: Her boyfriend waited outside the cinema with flowers.
boyfriend.example_zh: 她的男朋友拿着花在电影院外面等她。

bra.example_en: She bought a sports bra for gym class.
bra.example_zh: 她为体育课买了一件运动乳罩。

bracelet.example_en: Grandma gave me a silver bracelet on my birthday.
bracelet.example_zh: 我生日那天，奶奶送给了我一只银手环。

brain.example_en: A good sleep helps the brain stay sharp for exams.
brain.example_zh: 睡个好觉能让大脑在考试时保持清醒。

brainstorm.example_en: A sudden brainstorm gave her the idea for the poster.
brainstorm.example_zh: 她突然灵机一动，想出了海报的点子。

brainstorming.example_en: An hour of brainstorming gave us a name for the club.
brainstorming.example_zh: 一小时的自由讨论让我们为俱乐部想出了名字。

brake.example_en: The bus brake failed on the steep hill.
brake.example_zh: 公交车的刹车在陡坡上失灵了。

branch.example_en: The sports branch of the club meets on Saturdays.
branch.example_zh: 俱乐部的体育部门每星期六开会。

brand.example_en: This brand of milk is popular in our town.
brand.example_zh: 这个品牌的牛奶在我们镇上很受欢迎。

brass.example_en: The old bell is made of brass.
brass.example_zh: 那口旧钟是黄铜制成的。

Brazil.example_en: My cousin studies football in Brazil this year.
Brazil.example_zh: 我表哥今年在巴西学足球。

bread.example_en: Mum bought fresh bread from the corner shop.
bread.example_zh: 妈妈从街角的小店买了新鲜面包。

breakfast.example_en: I ate eggs and milk for breakfast today.
breakfast.example_zh: 我今天早餐吃了鸡蛋，喝了牛奶。

breakthrough.example_en: The lab reported a breakthrough in cancer research.
breakthrough.example_zh: 实验室报告了癌症研究方面的一项突破。

breast.example_en: The baby rested against his mother's breast.
breast.example_zh: 宝宝靠着妈妈的前胸休息。

breath.example_en: She held her breath before jumping into the pool.
breath.example_zh: 跳进泳池之前，她屏住了呼吸。

breeding.example_en: Horse breeding is important work on that farm.
breeding.example_zh: 马匹育种是那座农场的一项重要工作。

breeze.example_en: A soft breeze moved the curtains in the afternoon.
breeze.example_zh: 午后，一阵和风吹动了窗帘。

brick.example_en: Workers laid each brick carefully along the wall.
brick.example_zh: 工人们沿着墙把每块砖都仔细砌好。

bride.example_en: The bride smiled as she walked into the hall.
bride.example_zh: 新娘微笑着走进了大厅。

Britain.example_en: They spent the summer holiday in Britain.
Britain.example_zh: 他们的暑假是在英国度过的。

brother.example_en: My younger brother feeds the cat every morning.
brother.example_zh: 我弟弟每天早上给猫喂食。

bugger.example_en: Dad laughed and called Uncle Li an old bugger.
bugger.example_zh: 爸爸笑着管李叔叔叫老兄。

building.example_en: The new building beside the library has six floors.
building.example_zh: 图书馆旁边的新建筑物有六层楼。

bum.example_en: A tired bum slept on the station bench.
bum.example_zh: 一个疲惫的流浪汉睡在车站的长椅上。

bun.example_en: She ate a sweet bun on the way to school.
bun.example_zh: 她在上学的路上吃了一个甜面包。

burden.example_en: Heavy homework became a burden during exam week.
burden.example_zh: 考试那一周，繁重的作业成了沉重的担子。

bus.example_en: We missed the last bus and walked home.
bus.example_zh: 我们错过了末班公交车，只好走回家。

business.example_en: My uncle runs a small business near the market.
business.example_zh: 我叔叔在市场附近做着小生意。

butcher.example_en: The butcher cut the meat for our family dinner.
butcher.example_zh: 屠夫为我们的家庭晚餐切好了肉。

button.example_en: A button fell off my coat in the playground.
button.example_zh: 一颗扣子在操场上从我的外套掉了下来。

cable.example_en: The worker repaired the cable after the storm.
cable.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，工人把电缆修好了。

cake.example_en: We shared a chocolate cake at the birthday party.
cake.example_zh: 生日聚会上，我们分着吃了一个巧克力蛋糕。

camera.example_en: Dad brought his camera to the school sports day.
camera.example_zh: 爸爸带上相机来参加学校运动会。

camp.example_en: Our class stayed at a camp beside the lake.
camp.example_zh: 我们班住在湖边的营地里。

campaign.example_en: The new campaign asks families to save water at home.
campaign.example_zh: 新的运动号召家家户户在家里节约用水。

Canada.example_en: My aunt sends postcards from Canada every winter.
Canada.example_zh: 我姑姑每年冬天都从加拿大寄来明信片。

cancer.example_en: Doctors are working hard to treat lung cancer.
cancer.example_zh: 医生们正在努力治疗肺癌。

candidate.example_en: She is a candidate for class monitor this term.
candidate.example_zh: 她是这学期班长的人选。

capacity.example_en: The hall has a capacity of five hundred people.
capacity.example_zh: 这个大厅的容量是五百人。

car.example_en: Father washed the car on a sunny Sunday.
car.example_zh: 爸爸在一个晴朗的星期天清洗了汽车。

caravan.example_en: The caravan crossed the desert with food and water.
caravan.example_zh: 商队带着食物和水穿过了沙漠。

card.example_en: I wrote a thank-you card for my teacher.
card.example_zh: 我给老师写了一张感谢卡。

care.example_en: Her care for the sick dog moved the whole family.
care.example_zh: 她对生病小狗的关心感动了全家人。

Caribbean.example_en: They swam in the warm Caribbean during the holiday.
Caribbean.example_zh: 假期里，他们在温暖的加勒比海游了泳。

carpet.example_en: The red carpet in the hall looks very old.
carpet.example_zh: 大厅里的红地毯看上去非常旧了。

carrot.example_en: I chopped a carrot for the vegetable soup.
carrot.example_zh: 我切了一根胡萝卜来做蔬菜汤。

case.example_en: The case of the missing keys worried everyone.
case.example_zh: 钥匙不见了，这个情形让大家都担心。

cash.example_en: I paid in cash because the card machine failed.
cash.example_zh: 刷卡机坏了，所以我付了现金。

cat.example_en: Our cat sleeps on the sofa every afternoon.
cat.example_zh: 我们的猫每天下午都在沙发上睡觉。

catalogue.example_en: The library catalogue lists books by the author's name.
catalogue.example_zh: 图书馆目录按作者的姓名列出图书。

celebration.example_en: The victory celebration lasted until late at night.
celebration.example_zh: 胜利庆典一直持续到深夜。

cell.example_en: Each cell in the leaf needs sunlight to live.
cell.example_zh: 叶子里的每个细胞都需要阳光才能存活。

centre.example_en: The sports centre opens at eight on weekdays.
centre.example_zh: 体育中心在工作日八点开门。

century.example_en: This temple was built in the sixteenth century.
century.example_zh: 这座寺庙建于十六世纪。

certificate.example_en: She received a certificate after the swimming test.
certificate.example_zh: 游泳测验之后，她拿到了证书。

chain.example_en: He locked his bike with a strong chain.
chain.example_zh: 他用一根结实的链条把自行车锁上了。

chair.example_en: The empty chair by the window is still warm.
chair.example_zh: 窗边那把空椅子还是暖的。

chairman.example_en: The chairman opened the meeting with a short speech.
chairman.example_zh: 主席用一段简短的讲话开始了会议。

challenge.example_en: Climbing the hill was a real challenge for us.
challenge.example_zh: 爬上那座山对我们来说真是个挑战。

champion.example_en: She became the champion of the city chess match.
champion.example_zh: 她成了全市象棋比赛的冠军。

championship.example_en: The swimming championship will be held in our city.
championship.example_zh: 游泳冠军赛将在我们市举行。

chance.example_en: This match is our chance to reach the final.
chance.example_zh: 这场比赛是我们进入决赛的机会。

change.example_en: A sudden change in the weather cancelled the picnic.
change.example_zh: 天气突然改变，野餐只好取消。

channel.example_en: Boats passed through a narrow channel near the island.
channel.example_zh: 船只从岛附近一条狭窄的通道经过。

chap.example_en: A young chap offered his seat on the crowded bus.
chap.example_zh: 一个年轻家伙在拥挤的公交车上让出了座位。

chapter.example_en: The last chapter of the novel made her cry.
chapter.example_zh: 小说的最后一章让她哭了。

character.example_en: His honest character won the trust of his friends.
character.example_zh: 他诚实的性格赢得了朋友们的信任。

charge.example_en: The police dropped the charge after new evidence appeared.
charge.example_zh: 新证据出现后，警方撤销了这项指控。

chart.example_en: The weather chart shows rain for the whole week.
chart.example_zh: 天气图表显示整整一周都会下雨。

cheek.example_en: She kissed her mother on the cheek before school.
cheek.example_zh: 上学前，她亲了亲妈妈的脸颊。

cheese.example_en: He put cheese on the bread for a quick lunch.
cheese.example_zh: 他在面包上放了乳酪，当作一顿简单的午饭。

cheque.example_en: Mum wrote a cheque to pay the school fees.
cheque.example_zh: 妈妈开了一张支票来付学费。

chest.example_en: He felt a pain in his chest after the race.
chest.example_zh: 比赛结束后，他感到胸口疼痛。

chicken.example_en: The chicken in the yard laid an egg this morning.
chicken.example_zh: 院子里的鸡今天早上生了一枚蛋。

child.example_en: The child held his father's hand in the crowd.
child.example_zh: 孩子在人群中拉着爸爸的手。

China.example_en: Many tourists visit China during the spring holiday.
China.example_zh: 许多游客在春假期间来中国游玩。

chocolate.example_en: Dark chocolate is my favourite snack on cold days.
chocolate.example_zh: 黑巧克力是我在冷天最喜欢的零食。

choice.example_en: The menu offers a choice of rice or noodles.
choice.example_zh: 菜单提供米饭或面条的选择。

Christ.example_en: The church service celebrated the birth of Christ.
Christ.example_zh: 教堂礼拜庆祝基督的诞生。

Christian.example_en: My neighbour is a Christian and goes to church.
Christian.example_zh: 我的邻居是基督徒，常去教堂。

Christianity.example_en: Christianity shaped many holidays in that country.
Christianity.example_zh: 基督教影响了那个国家的许多节日。

Christmas.example_en: We hang lights on the tree at Christmas.
Christmas.example_zh: 圣诞节我们会在树上挂灯。

church.example_en: My grandparents walk to church on Sunday morning.
church.example_zh: 我的祖父母星期天早上步行去教堂。

cigarette.example_en: He threw the cigarette away before entering school.
cigarette.example_zh: 进学校之前，他把香烟扔了。

cinema.example_en: We watched a comedy at the cinema last Saturday.
cinema.example_zh: 上周六我们在电影院看了一部喜剧。

circle.example_en: She has a small circle of close friends at school.
circle.example_zh: 她在学校有一个由密友组成的小圈子。

circuit.example_en: A broken circuit left the desk lamp dark.
circuit.example_zh: 电路坏了，台灯就不亮了。

circumstances.example_en: Under these circumstances, the match should be delayed.
circumstances.example_zh: 在这种情况下，比赛应该推迟。

citizen.example_en: Every citizen can use the new public library.
citizen.example_zh: 每位公民都可以使用这座新的公共图书馆。

city.example_en: Noise in the city kept me awake last night.
city.example_zh: 城市里的噪音让我昨晚一直没睡着。

classroom.example_en: Posters of maps cover the classroom walls.
classroom.example_zh: 一张张地图海报贴满了教室的墙壁。

click.example_en: A loud click came from the broken door lock.
click.example_zh: 坏掉的门锁发出一声很响的咔嗒声。

client.example_en: The shopkeeper greeted a regular client by name.
client.example_zh: 店主喊着名字招呼一位老主顾。

clock.example_en: The kitchen clock stopped during the power cut.
clock.example_zh: 停电的时候，厨房的时钟停住了。

clothes.example_en: Wet clothes hung on the line behind the house.
clothes.example_zh: 湿衣服晾在屋后的绳子上。

clothing.example_en: Warm clothing is necessary for the mountain trip.
clothing.example_zh: 去山里需要准备暖和的服装。

club.example_en: She joined the art club after seeing the posters.
club.example_zh: 看到那些海报之后，她加入了美术俱乐部。

coach.example_en: The coach praised us for passing the ball well.
coach.example_zh: 教练夸我们传球传得很好。

coast.example_en: We walked along the coast and collected shells.
coast.example_zh: 我们沿着海岸走，还捡了些贝壳。

coat.example_en: She hung her coat by the door and sat down.
coat.example_zh: 她把外套挂在门边，然后坐了下来。

code.example_en: The door code is written in my notebook.
code.example_zh: 门的代码写在我的笔记本里。

coffee.example_en: Grandpa drinks coffee with milk every morning.
coffee.example_zh: 爷爷每天早上都喝加牛奶的咖啡。

Coke.example_en: I ordered a cold Coke with my hamburger.
Coke.example_zh: 我点汉堡时一起要了一杯冰可乐。
